title: NATS Per-Service Identity + ACL Registry
description: Single source of truth for NATS per-service authentication. Validates infrastructure/nats/services.yaml. Consumed by the CI invariant test nats-invariants.spec.ts.

version.description: Schema version. Bump only on breaking shape changes; add migration notes in ADR-015.

services.description: Ordered list of NATS services. Order is preserved by the nats.conf generator for auditable diffs.

name.description: NATS user identifier. MUST exactly match the mTLS client cert CN for this service (verify_and_map maps CN → user). Lowercase snake_case.

description.description: One-line summary of what this service publishes/consumes. Appears in ADR and runbook generation.

publish.description: Subjects this service is permitted to publish to. General JetStream clients use $JS.API.> plus _INBOX.>; a dedicated pre-provisioned pull consumer may instead use exact $JS.API.CONSUMER.INFO, $JS.API.CONSUMER.MSG.NEXT, and $JS.ACK.<stream>.<consumer>.> grants. Scoped reply inboxes use a purpose-specific first token matching _INBOX[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*. and are constrained to one publisher by the NATS invariant.

subscribe.description: Subjects this service is permitted to subscribe to. Pull-consumer delivery and JetStream API responses arrive on _INBOX.>; no $JS.API subscribe grant is required. Scoped reply inboxes use a purpose-specific first token matching _INBOX[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*. and are constrained to one subscriber by the NATS invariant.

subject.description: NATS subject pattern. Must begin with one of: events., commands., request., config.runtime., sensor., st.language., policy., $JS.API., $JS.ACK., _INBOX., or a purpose-specific scoped inbox token matching _INBOX[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*. — platform subject-space conventions enforced by SSoT. $JS.ACK is admitted only in the exact $JS.ACK.<stream>.<consumer>.> allow-grant shape; service-specific invariants pin its stream and durable suffix. Scoped tokens are distinct first tokens from `_INBOX.` so the platform-wide `_INBOX.>` grant cannot match them; the NATS invariant requires exactly one publisher and one subscriber for every scoped token. The legacy AQUACULTURE_EVENTS. prefix is STRUCTURALLY REJECTED (ORPHAN-HIGH-317): it is the JetStream stream NAME, never a subject prefix — grants written in that scheme are dead weight that silently deny the real events.* publishes. The `policy.` namespace carries dynamic-policy propagation (e.g. policy.ingest_backend.> — ADR-027 per-tenant toggle + ADR-031 request-reply snapshot); `sensor.lookup.by-topic` is the Rust sidecar cache-miss RPC (ADR-029); `config.runtime.get`/`config.runtime.get_secret` are config-service's request-reply reads for effective configuration (Billing Revival Faz C / D6).
